test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 8 is related to 40 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 3 is related to 15. To which of the following is 52 related to, following the same logic?
solution: Logic : (1st number × 5) = 2nd number Given : __ • 8 is related to 40 8 × 5__ = 40 40 = 40 (LHS = RHS) • 3 is related to 15
